title: compatgate.jsonc
description: The features that the project may use beyond its browserslist targets. See the README of @compatgate/core.

$schema.description: The path or the URL of this schema, for the editor. compatgate ignores it.

extends.description: Base configs, whose entries come first: a relative path, a package name (its compatgate.jsonc), or a .jsonc file inside a package. See https://github.com/compatgate/compatgate/tree/main/packages/core#compatgatejsonc

allow.description: The features that the project may use beyond its targets: a feature id, or an entry that limits it to packages or files. See https://github.com/compatgate/compatgate/tree/main/packages/core#compatgatejsonc

featureId.description: A feature id of @mdn/browser-compat-data, such as "api.structuredClone". Copy it from the message of a finding. See https://github.com/compatgate/compatgate/tree/main/packages/core#compatgatejsonc

packages.description: The entry applies only to the code of these packages. See https://github.com/compatgate/compatgate/tree/main/packages/core#compatgatejsonc

files.description: The entry applies only to these files: globs relative to this config. See https://github.com/compatgate/compatgate/tree/main/packages/core#compatgatejsonc
